headlines: AUDUSD: a bearish daily CRT — swept yesterday's high, closed back inside
Silver: a bullish daily CRT — swept yesterday's low, closed back inside
Oil took both sides of the Asian range

markets.name: AUDUSD
markets.story: AUDUSD fell 0.25% on a 28 pips range (61% of its 20-day average). The Asian low went first, at 02:03 New York in London, and the high followed at 05:02. Yesterday's high was taken at 18:00 the evening before. It swept yesterday's high and closed back inside — a bearish daily CRT. The busiest hour was 09:00 New York (14 pips).
markets.headline: AUDUSD: a bearish daily CRT — swept yesterday's high, closed back inside
